title: Shuffling eight indices
summary: $\mathcal{F}([0, \dots, 7], h)$: the entropy $h$ is stretched into 8 numbers $\mathcal{Q}_8(h)$, and each step uses the next one to pick an element of what is left.
params: no chain parameters: case 1 of the shuffle vectors
notes: $l$ is the length of what is left. The picked element is replaced by the last one, the last position is dropped, and $\mathbf{r}$ moves on by one, as in eq. F.1.
The 8 numbers of $\mathcal{Q}_8(h)$ are the eight four-octet words of $\mathcal{H}(h \frown \mathcal{E}_4(0))$ (eq. F.2).
name: shuffle-eight
check: The model's result equals the vector's expected order (the comparison `lake build shuffletest` makes on every shuffle vector), and each step above agrees with the model's `shuffle` on what is left.
